title: AstralAzeta's Amethyst Armor
description: This mod adds an amethyst armor
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6afd203cde7d4e9ec266c0b82256b621b59940f0.png) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Discord-Button-64.png)](https://discord.gg/hFS6faY9tW) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Modrinth-Button-64.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/astralazetas-amethyst-armor)
This Mod adds the amethyst armor. It's better than iron, but weaker than diamond. The recipe is the same as for vanilla armors, but with amethyst. ![Amethyst Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a068bbbdcb8669fd27e8b142ee3838e135d1cf3_0.webp) Created using [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/).
